caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with ornate carvings and upholstered seat and backrest. The wood of the chair appears brown, with decorative scrollwork along the top edge of the chair’s back. The armrests are curved and extend outward, with turned supports connecting to the seat. Both the backrest and the seat feature fabric upholstery in red and gold colors with an intricate floral pattern; the backrest’s upholstery is studded along the edges with round fasteners. The bottom edge of the seat is adorned with gold fringe trim. The legs of the chair are carved, with the front legs having elaborate designs and ending in claw-shaped feet. The entire chair is centered on an off-white background with no additional objects or scenery, and there is a small, handwritten inscription in the bottom right corner.
title: Hand-Carved Armchair
